purpose: Create the first mechanically valid trained JEPA teacher by rerunning the frozen reader-fit training schedule from a clean u0 under repaired F1-B/C3 mechanics. This contract contains no biological success threshold and authorizes no execution in draft state.

upstream_authorities.c2_causal_repair: Backward under fp16 autocast is the closed causal defect; repaired successor must execute scaled backward with autocast disabled.

initialization_policy.historical_u0_role: clean state reference/source only; never the new execution-authority checkpoint
forbidden: directly treating the historical u0 checkpoint as the new contract-bound checkpoint

required_new_u0.schema: successor-specific and bound to the final healthy-teacher contract

state_materialization_rule: If the reviewed successor is state-schema compatible, import clean model/optimizer/scaler/RNG state from historical u0, prove exact equality for every unchanged state tensor/value, then save a NEW successor-bound u0 checkpoint.
If any architecture/state-schema component changed, initialize that component prospectively under seed 8113002; unchanged components must still be equivalence-audited against historical u0.
No training data outcome or held-out biology may influence u0 construction.

corpus_and_address.normalization: production loader authority; no new normalization may be introduced by the training runner

sampler.schedule_semantics: capacity-constrained donor waterfill; q_d=min(8*N_d,lambda); keyed without-replacement donor cycles; deterministic donor tickets; same-update duplicate repair

model_and_masking.teacher_role: EMA target; requires_grad=False; no target gradients
model_and_masking.predictor_role: reviewed block predictor; exact registry bound before execution

optimizer.parameter_scope: online encoder + reviewed predictor trainable parameters
optimizer.ema_schedule: constant; exactly one EMA update after each proved valid optimizer step and never otherwise

precision_and_determinism.environment_rule: Exact software/GPU fingerprint must be captured before qualification. A materially changed runtime requires a fresh 40-update qualification.

pre_step_gradient_gate.magnitude_floor: none; any finite nonzero live gradient is eligible

optimizer_step_gate.rule: optimizer step must be mechanically proved; a GradScaler skip or absent step is a STOP

adam_moment_gate.timing: after proved optimizer step, before EMA
adam_moment_gate.scope: all mandatory backbone and reviewed predictor tensors

ema_gate.rule: EMA update occurs only after gradient gate + proved optimizer step + moment gate

movement_gate.scope: per mandatory tensor; pooled mean forbidden
movement_gate.nonzero_baseline_rule: must exceed reviewed analytical decay-only behavior

routing_predictor_gate.rule: F1-B defended routing/predictor/equivalence/AMP mechanics must remain defended under the integrated runner

qualification_phase.permitted_outputs: mechanics/resource/provenance only; no reader-validation/oracle or pathology biology
required_evidence: all 40 updates consume the exact frozen schedule rows and have 128 unique cells
all 48 mandatory backbone gradients are LIVE after unscale on every update
reviewed predictor mandatory gradients are LIVE after unscale on every update
no target parameter receives a gradient
no optimizer step is skipped or executed before the gate
both Adam moments are finite and nonzero for all mandatory tensors after each step
EMA count/equation matches every proved valid optimizer step
u40 per-tensor movement passes the reviewed decay-only adjudicator
checkpoint save/restore succeeds in a fresh process with exact state/RNG/cursor binding
no reader_validation, reader_oracle, foundation development/sealed, external holdout, or pathology path is opened

continuation_phase.full_horizon_basis: historical outcome-independent cap-8 schedule; last complete cap-safe update
continuation_requires: independent review of the u40 mechanics package returns PASS
same successor implementation and contract roots unchanged

checkpoint_and_resume.resume_rule: restore latest hash-verified checkpoint only; exact schedule/RNG/cursor agreement required; never resume defect-inherited historical u10-u205

biological_firewall.note: Training continuation is mechanics-only. Biological estimates are produced only after a trained checkpoint is frozen and separately authorized.

draft_blockers: integrated reviewed successor commit/source manifest root
independent external-review PASS for that integrated successor
exact reviewed movement adjudicator source SHA-256/formula/tolerance

known_nonfinal_successor_state.limitation: mechanics kernel is not yet the end-to-end production teacher-training runner and is not a valid execution binding for this contract
